# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1

FROM ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/baseimage-alpine-nginx:3.24

ENV LSIO_FIRST_PARTY=true

ARG BUILD_DATE
ARG VERSION
ARG GRAV_RELEASE
LABEL build_version="Linuxserver.io version:- ${VERSION} Build-date:- ${BUILD_DATE}"
LABEL maintainer="TheSpad"

RUN \
  echo "**** install runtime packages ****" && \
  apk add --no-cache \
    busybox-suid \
    nginx-mod-http-brotli \
    php85-dom \
    php85-gd \
    php85-intl \
    php85-ldap \
    php85-pdo \
    php85-pdo_sqlite \
    php85-pecl-apcu \
    php85-pecl-yaml \
    php85-redis \
    php85-tokenizer && \
  echo "**** configure php-fpm to pass env vars ****" && \
  sed -E -i 's/^;?clear_env ?=.*$/clear_env = no/g' /etc/php85/php-fpm.d/www.conf && \
  grep -qxF 'clear_env = no' /etc/php85/php-fpm.d/www.conf || echo 'clear_env = no' >> /etc/php85/php-fpm.d/www.conf && \
  echo "env[PATH] = /usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin" >> /etc/php85/php-fpm.conf && \
  echo "**** setup php opcache ****" && \
  { \
    echo 'opcache.memory_consumption=128'; \
    echo 'opcache.interned_strings_buffer=8'; \
    echo 'opcache.max_accelerated_files=4000'; \
    echo 'opcache.revalidate_freq=2'; \
    echo 'opcache.enable_cli=1'; \
  } > /etc/php85/conf.d/php-opcache.ini && \
  if [ -z ${GRAV_RELEASE+x} ]; then \
    GRAV_RELEASE=$(curl -sX GET "https://api.github.com/repos/getgrav/grav/releases/latest" \
    | jq -r '.tag_name'); \
  fi && \
  echo "*** Installing Grav ***" && \
  mkdir -p \
    /app/www/public && \
  curl -o \
    /tmp/grav.zip -L \
    "https://github.com/getgrav/grav/releases/download/${GRAV_RELEASE}/grav-admin-v${GRAV_RELEASE}.zip" && \
  unzip -q \
    /tmp/grav.zip -d /tmp/grav && \
  mv /tmp/grav/grav-admin/* /app/www/public/ && \
  printf "Linuxserver.io version: ${VERSION}\nBuild-date: ${BUILD_DATE}" > /build_version && \
  echo "**** cleanup ****" && \
  rm -rf \
    /tmp/* \
    $HOME/.cache \
    $HOME/.composer

# copy local files
COPY root/ /

# ports and volumes
EXPOSE 80 443

VOLUME /config

units.name: init-grav-config
units.script:
#!/usr/bin/with-contenv bash
# shellcheck shell=bash

# Symlink directories
symlinks=(
    /app/www/public/backup
    /app/www/public/logs
    /app/www/public/user
)

shopt -s globstar dotglob

for i in "${symlinks[@]}"; do
    if [[ -d /config/www/"$(basename "$i")" && ! -L "$i" ]]; then
        rm -rf "$i"
    fi
    if [[ ! -d /config/www/"$(basename "$i")" && ! -L "$i" ]]; then
        mv "$i" /config/www/
    fi
    if [[ -d /config/www/"$(basename "$i")" && ! -L "$i" ]]; then
        ln -s /config/www/"$(basename "$i")" "$i"
    fi
done

# Symlink files
symlinks=(
    /app/www/public/robots.txt
)

shopt -s globstar dotglob

for i in "${symlinks[@]}"; do
    if [[ -f /config/www/"$(basename "$i")" && ! -L "$i" ]]; then
        rm -rf "$i"
    fi
    if [[ ! -f /config/www/"$(basename "$i")" && ! -L "$i" ]]; then
        mv "$i" /config/www/
    fi
    if [[ -f /config/www/"$(basename "$i")" && ! -L "$i" ]]; then
        ln -s /config/www/"$(basename "$i")" "$i"
    fi
done

shopt -u globstar dotglob

# permissions
lsiown -R abc:abc \
    /app \
    /config/www

notes.upstream:
### Improved
- Added Maltese (`mt`, Malti) to the language codes [#4408](https://github.com/getgrav/grav/pull/4408)

### Bugfix
- A scheduler run started from the admin on a host where PHP's `proc_open` is disabled skips the command jobs it can't start instead of recording them as failed, and still runs the jobs that call PHP, such as backups. `Scheduler::canRun($job)` tells the two apart [#4397](https://github.com/getgrav/grav/issues/4397)
- Retina images up to `@10x` are grouped with their base image again, as on 1.7, instead of `@5x` and higher showing up as separate media. Missing steps are still only generated up to `@4x`, and deleting the base image no longer removes files above the limit that are listed on their own [admin2#214](https://github.com/getgrav/grav-plugin-admin2/issues/214)
- A `summary:` setting left empty in `user/config/site.yaml`, such as one whose lines are all commented out, no longer stops page summaries with an "Undefined array key" error (seen on simplesearch results). Summaries fall back to the shipped settings instead [simplesearch#211](https://github.com/getgrav/grav-plugin-simplesearch/issues/211)

reasons: repository files that reach the image changed (image.yml or root/)
9 commits (828de0f → ea0e053): changed image.yml, generated files, the package table
